findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 119 requests to 7 third-party domains (median of 4 passes).
Of 11.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 975 kB (8%) came from third-party domains, 14 kB of it from services classified as tracking (2 requests).

1 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: tracking.ringieraxelspringer.tech (Ringier Axel Springer Tech, analytics).

A consent banner was detected, but our detector found no one-click reject button on its first layer (it may sit behind a settings or options button). Nothing was clicked. The banner offered a paid option instead (“Jetzt BILD PUR abonnieren”). The consent tool appeared to be Sourcepoint.

After the banner's accept button (“Alle akzeptieren”) was pressed, 51 tracking services were contacted in the following 12 seconds, 51 of them not seen before the click (1rx.io, 360yield.com, 3lift.com, adform.net, adnxs.com, adsrvr.org, amazon-adsystem.com, bat.bing.com). Before the click: 1. Third-party cookies went from 0 to 139 (median of 2 passes). The consent tool appeared to be Sourcepoint.
